description: AAASM-5344: clean Traditional-Chinese prose — no findings. Chinese does not delimit words with spaces, so each clause is one whitespace token whose multi-byte length lands inside the 20–64 window the entropy gate was calibrated on characters for; scoring its UTF-8 bytes then puts Han above the 4.5 bits/char gate and reports ordinary prose as leaked secrets. All three clauses here sit in that window and score 4.63–4.85 bits/byte, so this vector fires the defect directly unless the entropy pass narrows to ASCII runs before scoring.
